headline_marked: Wear OS 7 launches with [[Gemini AI]] and 10% battery boost
headline: Wear OS 7 launches with Gemini AI and 10% battery boost
summary: Google's latest smartwatch OS brings AI-powered widgets, improved media controls, and better battery life to Pixel Watches starting June 16.
details: Google has officially announced Wear OS 7, rolling out to compatible Pixel Watch models starting June 16. The new operating system is built from the ground up to enhance connectivity with other devices, including earbuds and Google's future smartglasses.

A key feature is the integration of Gemini AI, enabling users to create custom dashboards and widgets simply by verbally describing them to the AI. This allows for highly personalized smartwatch experiences.

Wear OS 7 also introduces 'Live Updates', providing at-a-glance information for time-sensitive activities like delivery progress or live sports scores. This feature aims to keep users informed without needing to constantly check their phones.

Media controls for earbuds and smart home speakers are improved, with the ability to seamlessly switch audio playback between devices. Additionally, Wear OS 7 offers system-level power optimizations, promising an average of 10% longer battery life for users.

The update is compatible with Google Pixel Watch 2, Pixel Watch 3, and Pixel Watch 4. While Google has not provided a precise rollout schedule, the update begins distribution on June 16. Other brands using Wear OS will announce their own release plans.
